name: Spoke
author: Erin Carter
description: A starburst of glowing tubes radiating from the centre, charge shooting outward along each ray while the hue steps spoke to spoke. A softly lit ground fills the wedges between.

params.label: Scale
params.effect: Overall reference scale in CSS pixels - sets how quickly the rays thicken outward and how far the charge has to travel.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing ray in CSS pixels, from a hairline spoke to a fat neon beam.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge shooting outward along the rays; 0 freezes it, high fires bright pulses to the rim.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each ray; low is a crisp drawn spoke, high a luminous bloom flooding the wedges.

params.label: Rays
params.effect: Number of rays in the starburst, from a sparse compass rose to a dense radiant fan.

params.label: Colour blend
params.effect: Heals the colour seam on the left ray where the hue wraps; low keeps the original spoke-to-spoke steps with the seam, high steps through three seamless rainbows around the burst.

params.label: Bead fill
params.effect: Fraction of cells along the rays that light as a soft glowing bead riding the tube; 0 leaves clean spokes, high strings each ray with LEDs.

params.label: Bead size
params.effect: Size of each lit bead within its cell, from a small point to a fat blob spanning the gap between beads.

params.label: Twinkle
params.effect: Makes the beads breathe in and out, each on its own random phase, so the rays shimmer.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls which cells light and their twinkle phases for a fresh arrangement of beads on the same burst.

params.label: Centre X
params.effect: Slides the hub left or right, in short-axis units, so the rays radiate from an off-centre point.

params.label: Centre Y
params.effect: Slides the hub up or down, in short-axis units, so the rays radiate from an off-centre point.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole starburst about its hub, in degrees.

params.label: Tilt
params.effect: Rocks the burst fore and back in a perspective-ish tilt, so the fan reads as lying away from or toward the viewer.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Leans the burst left or right, shearing the fan off its upright axis for an angled, in-space read.
